display_long_description:
You're a monke with a plot of land and $150. Time to fix that.

Monke Mine Tycoon is a multiplayer mining tycoon where you move with your arms, Gorilla Tag style. Slap a CLAIM button, open the shop on your wrist and start building.

HOW IT WORKS
Droppers spit out ore. Belts carry it. Upgraders multiply what it's worth. Furnaces turn it into cash. Grab a mini machine off your wrist tablet, aim at your plot and let go. It flies out of your hand and lands on the grid.

THINGS TO DO
Unlock 55 machines, from basic droppers to gambling machines and resetters. Research better gear, rebirth to start over stronger and earn exclusive machines you can't buy. Your mine keeps earning while you're away, and after a rebirth your old layout rebuilds itself.

Climb the boulders and hunt down treasure chests that refill every day. Level up your monke, grab daily gifts, quests, achievements and crates, and chase the leaderboards. Deck out your robot with hats, glowing hands and swing trails.

MULTIPLAYER
Up to 4 monkes per lobby with voice chat, and everyone gets a plot. Share a room code to play with friends or make a private room. Nobody can touch your plot or your cash, so show off all you want.

We're updating it all the time, so tell us what breaks.
